spotlight: In 2024, 30 people ran our outbound research by hand.
stories.headline: SalesCaptain replaced 30 outbound researchers with 5 people and Clay

poster.about: SalesCaptain runs outbound campaigns for B2B companies.

stories.why: AI handles research and prep. Humans earn the conversation.
stories.note: Per his post: SDRs, AEs and GTM engineers now split the work that 30 did.
stories.take: The team that automates research first will outprice every agency that still does it by hand.

spotlight: Never let your AI SDR send its first 1,000 emails without manually reviewing every single one.
stories.headline: Jason Lemkin: read every one of your AI SDR’s first 1,000 emails

poster.about: SaaStr runs the largest SaaS community and annual conference.

stories.why: Spot-checking misses pricing errors, hallucinated features and wrong segments.
stories.note: Per his post: after 1,000 reviews, 20 to 30 minutes of daily checks is enough.
stories.take: Trust is built in the first thousand. Skip them and your brand pays the price.

spotlight: Sending from Google gets us 4.1X the replies.
stories.headline: After 10 million cold emails: Google inboxes get 4.1x the replies

poster.about: Pipeline helps companies build and run outbound sales systems.

stories.why: The sender infrastructure matters as much as the copy.
stories.note: Per his post: calls booked 62% of meetings from 44% of touches. 10M+ emails, 700k+ calls.
stories.take: Google inbox, clean list, then call. Three moves that still beat any prompt trick.
